column2: Economists studying tax incidence found that consumers, not sellers, bore most of the burden because demand for salt barely changes.
column3: 研究稅負轉嫁的經濟學家發現，負擔大多落在消費者而非賣方身上，因為鹽的需求幾乎不變。
column4: study tax incidence (研究稅負歸宿)
column5: incidence 落在誰頭上：稅像球，丟給賣家還是買家接住？
column8: 稅負轉嫁；買賣雙方依彈性分擔稅負

column2: The Laffer curve implies that raising rates beyond a certain point can shrink total government revenue.
column3: 拉弗曲線意味著，稅率提高超過某一點後，政府的總稅收可能反而減少。
column4: the Laffer curve suggests (拉弗曲線顯示)
column5: Laffer 像 laugh 笑；曲線像山丘，稅率爬太高，稅收反而滑下來
column8: 拉弗曲線；稅率過高反使總稅收衰退

column2: Fiscal drag occurred as inflation lifted nominal wages, pushing workers into higher tax brackets without any real raise.
column3: 通膨推高名目薪資，使勞工在沒有實質加薪下被推進較高稅率級距，造成了財政拖累。
column4: cause fiscal drag (造成財政拖累)
column5: drag 拖著走，通膨像繩子把人往高稅率那邊拖
column8: 財政拖累；通膨將納稅人推入更高稅率級距

column2: Bracket creep left retirees paying more income tax each year, though their purchasing power had not improved.
column3: 稅率級距爬升，使退休者每年繳更多所得稅，儘管他們的購買力並沒有提高。
column4: suffer bracket creep (遭遇稅率級距爬升)
column5: creep 偷偷爬：薪水悄悄爬進更貴的稅率格子
column8: 稅率級距爬升；實質所得未增而名目稅負加重

column2: Many shell companies register in a tax haven, where profits face a near-zero rate and ownership stays hidden.
column3: 許多空殼公司在避稅天堂註冊，在那裡利潤只適用接近零的稅率，所有權也不公開。
column4: use a tax haven (利用避稅天堂)
column5: haven 避風港，tax 稅：躲稅的港灣，像海盜的島
column8: 避稅天堂；極低稅率或零稅率的境外地區

column2: Base erosion occurs when multinationals shift profits to low-tax countries, leaving the home government with a shrinking taxable amount.
column3: 當跨國企業把利潤轉移到低稅國家，使母國政府可課稅金額縮小時，就發生了稅基侵蝕。
column4: combat base erosion (對抗稅基侵蝕)
column5: erosion 侵蝕像海浪刷海岸，稅基被一點一點沖走
column8: 稅基侵蝕；跨國企業利潤移轉的避稅手法

column2: Tax authorities challenged the firm's transfer pricing, saying it charged its own subsidiary too little to move profit abroad.
column3: 稅務機關質疑這家公司的移轉訂價，指它向自家子公司收費過低，以便把利潤移往海外。
column4: set transfer pricing (設定移轉訂價)
column5: transfer 轉移，pricing 定價：自家人互賣時開個方便價
column8: 移轉訂價；關係企業跨境交易的定價

column2: Thin capitalization rules limit how much interest a subsidiary may deduct when funded mostly by loans from its parent.
column3: 資本稀釋規定限制子公司在主要由母公司貸款供應資金時，可扣除多少利息。
column4: thin capitalization rules (資本稀釋規定)
column5: thin 薄：自己出的股本很薄，借來的錢卻堆得很厚
column7: thin cap - i - tal - i - za - tion
column8: 資本稀釋；藉大量關係人借貸以利息抵稅

column2: After energy prices soared, lawmakers passed a windfall tax on the oil companies' unexpectedly large profits.
column3: 能源價格飆升後，議員們對石油公司意外豐厚的利潤課徵暴利稅。
column4: impose a windfall tax (課徵暴利稅)
column5: windfall 是風吹落的果子，意外多賺的錢被稅
column8: 暴利稅；對意外超額所得徵收的特別稅

column2: At every stage from farm to shop, value-added tax is collected only on the value created at that stage.
column3: 從農場到商店的每個階段，加值型營業稅只針對該階段創造的價值徵收。
column4: charge value-added tax (課徵加值型營業稅)
column5: value 價值 + added 增加：每多加一分價值，就多課一分稅
column8: 加值型營業稅；每個生產階段逐級課稅

column2: The government raised the excise duty on cigarettes and alcohol to discourage consumption and fund healthcare.
column3: 政府提高香菸與酒類的貨物稅，以抑制消費並籌措醫療經費。
column4: pay excise duty (繳納貨物稅)
column5: excise 唸「ɛk-saɪz」，專門對特定商品「切一塊」的稅
column8: 貨物稅；對菸酒等特定商品課徵的消費稅

column2: Buyers of the flat had to pay stamp duty equal to three percent of the purchase price.
column3: 這間公寓的買家必須繳納相當於買價百分之三的印花稅。
column4: pay stamp duty (繳納印花稅)
column5: stamp 郵票印章：文件蓋章生效，同時要交稅
column8: 印花稅；房屋交易與法律文件課徵的稅

column2: Selling the shares at a profit made her liable for capital gains tax on the difference from her purchase price.
column3: 以獲利賣出股票，使她需就與買進價格的差額繳納資本利得稅。
column4: pay capital gains tax (繳納資本利得稅)
column5: capital gain 資本的利得：賣掉資產多賺的那一段才被課
column8: 資本利得稅；出售股票或房產獲利時課徵

column2: When the farmer died, his children had to sell part of the land to cover the estate tax.
column3: 農夫過世時，他的子女必須賣掉一部分土地，來支付遺產稅。
column4: owe estate tax (需繳遺產稅)
column5: estate 是房產與財產，人離世後留下的才被稅
column8: 遺產稅；對死後遺留資產移轉所課的稅

column2: Giving each grandchild a large sum triggered gift tax once the amount passed the annual exemption.
column3: 給每個孫子一大筆錢，一旦金額超過年度免稅額，就觸發贈與稅。
column4: file a gift tax return (申報贈與稅)
column5: gift 禮物也會被稅：送出去的禮，送的人要報稅
column8: 贈與稅；對生前無償贈與課徵的稅負

column2: Under a progressive tax, a cashier pays a lower percentage of income than a senior executive does.
column3: 在累進稅制下，收銀員繳納的所得百分比比資深主管低。
column4: adopt a progressive tax (採行累進稅制)
column5: progress 前進：收入往前爬，稅率也跟著往上升
column8: 累進稅率；收入愈高適用邊際稅率愈高

column2: A regressive tax such as a flat sales fee takes a larger share of income from low earners.
column3: 像固定銷售費這種累退稅，會從低收入者身上拿走更大比例的所得。
column4: a regressive tax burden (累退稅負擔)
column5: regress 倒退：收入越少，比例反而被拿越多
column8: 累退稅率；低收入者負擔比例較重的稅

column2: With a proportional tax of ten percent, a family earning more simply pays proportionally more, and the rate never changes.
column3: 實施百分之十的比例稅，收入較高的家庭只是等比例多繳，稅率始終不變。
column4: levy a proportional tax (課徵比例稅)
column5: proportion 比例：每個人都交同一個百分比
column8: 單一比例稅率；不論所得高低適用固定稅率

column2: Mortgage interest is a tax deduction that lowers the amount of income on which the owner is taxed.
column3: 房貸利息是一項所得扣除額，可降低屋主被課稅的所得金額。
column4: claim a tax deduction (申請稅前扣除)
column5: deduct 扣除：先從收入扣掉，剩下的才算稅
column8: 所得扣除額；減少應稅所得的支出項目

column2: A solar panel tax credit cut the homeowner's final bill by thirty percent of the installation cost.
column3: 太陽能板的租稅抵減，讓屋主的最終稅單減少了安裝成本的百分之三十。
column4: claim a tax credit (申請租稅抵減)
column5: credit 像折價券：直接從稅單上扣一塊錢
column8: 租稅抵減；直接扣抵應納稅額的減免

column2: The law of demand explains why the café sold more lattes after cutting the price by a dollar.
column3: 需求法則解釋了為什麼咖啡館把價格降一塊錢後，拿鐵賣得更多。
column4: obey the law of demand (符合需求法則)
column5: 價格往下走，想買的人往上走，像蹺蹺板
column8: 需求法則；價格與需求量反向變動

column2: According to the law of supply, farmers plant more wheat when its market price climbs.
column3: 依據供給法則，小麥市價上漲時，農民會種植更多小麥。
column4: the law of supply holds (供給法則成立)
column5: 價格往上走，賣家願意出的貨也跟著往上走
column8: 供給法則；價格與供給量同向變動

column2: The consumer price index rose four percent, meaning the typical household basket cost noticeably more than a year earlier.
column3: 消費者物價指數上升百分之四，意味典型家庭購物籃的花費明顯高於一年前。
column4: the consumer price index (消費者物價指數)
column5: consumer 消費者，price 價格，縮寫 CPI：測量你買菜貴了多少
column7: con - sum - er price in - dex
column8: 消費者物價指數；CPI 衡量民生通膨

column2: Factory-gate prices measured by the producer price index often foreshadow later increases on supermarket shelves.
column3: 以生產者物價指數衡量的出廠價格，常預示之後超市貨架上的漲價。
column4: the producer price index (生產者物價指數)
column5: producer 生產者，縮寫 PPI：看工廠賣出去的價格
column7: pro - duc - er price in - dex
column8: 生產者物價指數；上游出廠物價

column2: Policymakers watched the core inflation rate because it removes volatile food and energy prices that can mislead short-term judgments.
column3: 決策者關注核心通膨，因為它剔除了可能誤導短期判斷的波動性食品與能源價格。
column4: core inflation rate (核心通膨率)
column5: core 蘋果核：剝掉會忽上忽下的外皮，只看核心
column8: 核心通膨率；剔除能源與糧食的波動

column2: A purchasing managers index above fifty indicates that factory activity is expanding rather than contracting.
column3: 採購經理人指數高於五十，顯示工廠活動正在擴張而不是萎縮。
column4: purchasing managers index (採購經理人指數)
column5: 問採購經理人今天忙不忙，五十分是榮枯分界
column7: pur - chas - ing man - ag - ers in - dex
column8: 採購經理人指數；PMI 榮枯線判斷景氣

column2: Gross domestic product measures the total value of goods and services produced within a country's borders in a year.
column3: 國內生產毛額衡量一個國家一年內在境內生產的商品與服務總值。
column4: gross domestic product (國內生產毛額)
column5: domestic 國內，gross 總的，縮寫 GDP：家裡生產的總和
column7: gross do - mes - tic prod - uct
column8: 國內生產毛額；GDP 境內產出總量

column2: Gross national product counts income earned by a nation's citizens, including profits their firms make abroad.
column3: 國民生產毛額計算一國公民賺取的所得，包括其企業在海外賺的利潤。
column4: gross national product (國民生產毛額)
column5: national 國民：看人不看地，國民在哪賺都算，縮寫 GNP
column7: gross na - tion - al prod - uct
column8: 國民生產毛額；GNP 全體國民的產出

column2: Real gross domestic product removes the effect of rising prices, showing whether output truly grew over the decade.
column3: 實質國內生產毛額剔除物價上漲的影響，顯示產出在這十年是否真的成長。
column4: real gross domestic product (實質國內生產毛額)
column5: real 真實：用固定價格算，才看得出真的有沒有變多
column7: real gross do - mes - tic prod - uct
column8: 實質 GDP；扣除物價波動後的實質成長

column2: Nominal gross domestic product looked impressive, but most of the growth came from inflation rather than extra output.
column3: 名目國內生產毛額看起來亮眼，但大部分成長來自通膨，而不是額外的產出。
column4: nominal gross domestic product (名目國內生產毛額)
column5: nominal 只是名義上的，用當時標價算，不管物價漲沒漲
column7: nom - i - nal gross do - mes - tic prod - uct
column8: 名目 GDP；以當期市場價格計算的產值

column2: Per capita income in the region doubled, so the average resident can now afford a car and a better home.
column3: 該地區的每人平均所得翻了一倍，所以一般居民現在買得起車和更好的房子。
column4: per capita income (每人平均所得)
column5: per 每 + capita 人頭（拉丁文）：總所得除以人數
column7: per cap - i - ta in - come
column8: 每人平均所得；國民財富普及度指標

column2: Disposable personal income, what households keep after paying taxes, determines how much they can spend or save.
column3: 可支配個人所得，也就是家庭繳稅後留下的錢，決定了他們能花多少或存多少。
column4: disposable personal income (可支配個人所得)
column5: disposable 可任意處置的，扣完稅剩下能自己用的錢
column7: dis - pos - a - ble per - son - al in - come
column8: 個人可支配所得；繳稅後可用於消費的金額

column2: When prices rose, families cut discretionary spending on dining out and vacations before touching rent or groceries.
column3: 物價上漲時，家庭先削減外食和度假這類非必要支出，才去動房租或食品雜貨。
column4: cut discretionary spending (削減非必要支出)
column5: discretion 自行斟酌：可買可不買、由你決定的花費
column7: dis - cre - tion - ar - y spend - ing
column8: 非必要支出；休閒娛樂等隨意消費

column2: A high marginal propensity to consume means households spend most of any extra dollar they receive.
column3: 邊際消費傾向高，表示家庭會把多拿到的每一塊錢大部分花掉。
column4: a high marginal propensity to consume (高邊際消費傾向)
column5: propensity 傾向；多賺一塊，有多少比例衝去消費
column7: mar - gin - al pro - pen - si - ty to con - sume
column8: 邊際消費傾向；每增加所得花掉的比例

column2: If the marginal propensity to save is 0.3, a household puts thirty cents of every extra dollar into savings.
column3: 如果邊際儲蓄傾向是 0.3，家庭每多賺一塊錢就會存下三十分。
column4: the marginal propensity to save (邊際儲蓄傾向)
column5: save 儲蓄；它和消費傾向加起來剛好等於一
column7: mar - gin - al pro - pen - si - ty to save
column8: 邊際儲蓄傾向；每增加所得存下的比例

column2: Expansionary monetary policy, such as cutting interest rates, aims to revive a slumping economy by encouraging borrowing and spending.
column3: 寬鬆貨幣政策，例如降息，目的是鼓勵借貸與消費，讓低迷的經濟復甦。
column4: adopt expansionary monetary policy (採行寬鬆貨幣政策)
column5: expand 擴張像吹氣球：錢變多，經濟也跟著鼓起來
column7: ex - pan - sion - ar - y mon - e - tar - y pol - i - cy
column8: 寬鬆貨幣政策；降息購債以刺激內需

column2: Contractionary monetary policy raised interest rates sharply to cool runaway inflation, even at the cost of slower growth.
column3: 緊縮貨幣政策大幅升息，抑制失控的通膨，即使代價是成長放緩。
column4: pursue contractionary monetary policy (推行緊縮貨幣政策)
column5: contract 收縮像洩氣的球：錢變少，物價跑慢一點
column7: con - trac - tion - ar - y mon - e - tar - y pol - i - cy
column8: 緊縮貨幣政策；升息以抑制惡性通膨

column2: Quantitative tightening shrank the central bank's balance sheet as maturing bonds were left to expire without replacement.
column3: 量化緊縮使央行的資產負債表縮小，因為到期債券被放任到期而沒有再買進。
column4: begin quantitative tightening (開始量化緊縮)
column5: tighten 收緊，quantitative 量的：把水龍頭轉小，回收市場的錢
column7: quan - ti - ta - tive tight - en - ing
column8: 量化緊縮；縮減資產負債表以回收資金

column2: Through forward guidance, the bank hinted that rates would stay low for another year, calming nervous investors.
column3: 透過前瞻指引，央行暗示利率還會再低一年，使緊張的投資人安心下來。
column4: provide forward guidance (提供前瞻指引)
column5: forward 向前，guidance 指引：像導遊先告訴你前面的路
column8: 央行前瞻指引；預告未來利率路徑

column2: Inflation targeting commits the central bank to steer price growth toward two percent, anchoring public expectations.
column3: 通膨目標制讓央行承諾把物價漲幅導向百分之二，穩住大眾的預期。
column4: adopt inflation targeting (採行通膨目標制)
column5: target 靶心，把物價漲幅射向 2% 的紅心
column7: in - fla - tion tar - get - ing
column8: 通膨目標制；央行錨定 2% 通膨基準
